### A computer of his own

A private Linux desktop in the cloud with Chrome, kept just for you. Logins you give him stay there, so the next task picks up where the last one left off.

### Routines

“Every weekday at 8:00, summarise my inbox.” He sets it up and runs it on your clock, even when your PC is off.

### Sleeps when idle

His computer naps when he isn’t working and wakes in about ten seconds when you ask. That’s how we keep the price low.

### Chat history

Every request and answer is kept on his computer. Reply to carry on where you left off, days later.

### Signed and private

A code-signed Windows app. Your PC is paired to his computer with its own key, and nobody else can reach it.

### Watch over his shoulder

Open his live screen anytime, follow every step in the activity log, and stop him with one click.
